newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Nov 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egypt and the United States sign 10 grant agreements worth a total $416.1 million.
- Egyptian oil ministry says Egypt has discovered a new gas field beneath the Mediterranean.

- The Organisation of the Islamic Conference is putting its weight behind businesses in member countries which want to set up an Islamic shipping company with a proposed capital of $250 million, to be based in Jeddah.
- United Arab Emirates Central Bank says to take legal steps against financial companies working in the country without its permission.
